scope: Independent real owner handlers, installed Blobs SDK conditional storage and locally intercepted Google protocol. No live provider/account/model/network activity; no production activation.

checks.name: Two normal owner APIs connect separate Google calendars without a named tenant list
New ordinary booking IDs create, update, and cancel exact tenant events without duplicates
Setup and practice samples neither enqueue nor retain authority for Calendar or owner notifications
A connection gate closed after real CAS reservation stops transport and keeps spent capacity
Policy edits and UTC rollover after reservation refuse transport rather than reuse old authority
Global and tenant actual-SDK conditional caps arbitrate simultaneous transport without reset
Paused and exhausted customers retain local desired work without localOnly transport authority
Changed source identity, conflicting markers, and wrong targets fail before physical attempts
Google client and policy changes during OAuth reject before token exchange
OAuth requires the original active session; ordinary signout does not revoke a saved background grant
Malformed explicit self-service policy fails closed despite retained named proof settings
V1 forwarding names the business line, avoids carrier code guessing, and handles new-number mode
